left.heading: DSC
left.alt: Wiring diagram: DSC panel keypad bus to GET. RED to +DC (+12V), BLK to -DC, YEL to CLK, GRN to DATA.

right.heading: PARADOX
right.alt: Wiring diagram: PARADOX panel serial port to GET through the EX-CRP2.4 cable (ordered separately). R (red, +12V) to +DC, B (black) to -DC, Y (yellow) to CLK, G (green) to DATA.

left.heading: CADDX
left.alt: Wiring diagram: CADDX panel keypad bus to GET. POS to +DC (+12V), COM to -DC, DATA to DATA; CLK is not used.

right.heading: TEXECOM
right.alt: Wiring diagram: TEXECOM panel serial port to GET through the EX-CRP4 cable (ordered separately). R (red, +12V) to +DC, B (black) to -DC, BL (blue) to CLK, W (white) to DATA.

left.heading: INNERRANGE INCEPTION
left.alt: Wiring diagram: Inner Range Inception to GET. VOUT + (+12V) to +DC and VOUT 0V to -DC; from the panel's USB port through Inner Range cable 993030USB: black wire to the 0V/-DC line, green wire to CLK, white wire to DATA.

right.heading: INNERRANGE INTEGRITI
right.alt: Wiring diagram: Inner Range Integriti Port 0 to GET through Inner Range cable INTG-996795. +DET (+13V) to +DC, GND 5 to -DC, Rx 3 to CLK, Tx 2 to DATA.

left.heading: Honeywell Vista-15, Vista-20, Vista-48
left.alt: Wiring diagram: Honeywell Vista-15, Vista-20, Vista-48 panel keypad bus to GET. Terminal 4 to -DC, terminal 5 to +DC (+12V), terminal 6 to DATA, terminal 7 to CLK.

right.heading: Control panel (telephone line communicator, TIP/RING)
right.alt: Wiring diagram: control panel to GET over its telephone line communicator. +AUX to +DC (+12 V), -AUX to -DC; telephone line communicator terminals: panel TIP to GET TIP, panel RING to GET RING.
